## BArchivable

[`BArchivable`](BArchivable.md "BArchivable") is a protocol for archiving and unarchiving objects. When you archive an object, you record its state into a [`BMessage`](BMessage.md "BMessage") that can be sent to another application, flattened and saved as a file, cached in memory, and so on. Unarchiving does the opposite: It takes a [`BMessage`](BMessage.md "BMessage") archive and turns it into a functioning object.

See "[Archiving](TheSupportKit_Archiving.md "Archiving")" for more information on the BeOS archival system.
